name: Status Trail 13
definition: Provides the history of status and reasons for a pending, posted or cancelled transaction.

StatusDate.name: Status Date
StatusDate.definition: Date and time at which the status was assigned.

SendingOrganisationIdentification.name: Sending Organisation Identification
SendingOrganisationIdentification.definition: Unique and unambiguous way to identify the organisation that sent the message instance.

UserIdentification.name: User Identification
UserIdentification.definition: Unique and unambiguous way to identify the user that created the message instance.

ProcessingStatus.name: Processing Status
ProcessingStatus.definition: Provides details on the processing status of the transaction.

InferredMatchingStatus.name: Inferred Matching Status
InferredMatchingStatus.definition: Provides the matching status of an instruction as per the account servicer or the Market Infrastructure based on an allegement. At this time no matching took place on the market (at the CSD/ICSD/MI).

MatchingStatus.name: Matching Status
MatchingStatus.definition: Provides the matching status of the instruction.

SettlementStatus.name: Settlement Status
SettlementStatus.definition: Provides the status of settlement of a transaction.

ModificationProcessingStatus.name: Modification Processing Status
ModificationProcessingStatus.definition: Provides details on the modification processing status of the transaction.

CancellationStatus.name: Cancellation Status
CancellationStatus.definition: Provides details on the processing status of the cancellation request.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.
